data.name: Nawwal
data.gender_notes: Nawwal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nawwala' which means 'to delight', 'to give pleasure', or 'to make joyful'. In Islamic tradition, the name Nawwal is believed to represent the joy and happiness that comes from following the path of righteousness and living in accordance with the teachings of the Quran. The name Nawwal carries the meaning “Delight, pleasure, joy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawwal usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes the joy and happiness of following the path of righteousness in Islam.
data.etymology: Nawwal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, pleasure, joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nawwal total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
